title: Interphase hand-off: amendment 1 (recorder C1) handed off after three reviews, build it on mitosis/recorder
context: Amendment 1 to recorder-comets-and-fixes fixes the recorder round-1 blocker C1 MEDIUM (onset baseline reset on pause: the Comets model's stage setter calls _smoother.hear(0) on leaving recording, so a steady voice across a pause fires a false onset). It adds to 16.17 the domain resume-reference (less than 0.15 above it / 0.15 or more above it / no level heard before the pause), two acceptance rows in test/features/capture/immersive/voice_level_field_test.dart, the fact f-pause-hears-zero, and the Step comets-resume-onset-reference (MSP recorder-amend-1, files voice_level_field.dart, voice_level_smoother.dart, voice_level_field_test.dart). Review 1 found a Testability gap (no row in the 0.15-or-more class), fixed by reshaping the second row; review 2 found an Outside fact (a sentence claiming Android sends levels while paused, false per record-7.1.1 record.dart:205-209), fixed by restoring the original sentence; review 3 approved. Guard verify was clean on the checkout and the recorder worktree, check_record --complete passes with status handed-off. amend-1.zsh --plan-only (plan 416056392379): 1 Step, 1 Lane, 1 MSP, exit 0.
options: Build amendment 1 now with amend-1.zsh on feature branch mitosis/recorder, then merge into mitosis/recorder and mitosis/voice-peaks and review recorder round 2
Write amendments 2 and 3 first and build all three together
Patch voice_level_field.dart by hand in the recorder worktree
option_reasons: The pipeline runs amendments one after another, each built by mitosis from its own amend-U+003Ca>.zsh with --plan-only first, then merged into the MSP branch and the MSPs stacked on it before the next round.
The rule runs amendments one after another, and voice-peaks is stacked on recorder, so recorder's fix must merge into voice-peaks before voice-peaks's own amendment builds.
Fixes go back through interphase and mitosis; the main thread never edits an MSP's code outside a mitosis run.
outcome: Build amendment 1 with /Users/satanshumishra/.mitosis/field-notes/recorder-comets-and-fixes/amend-1.zsh (items amend-1.items.json, run dir ~/.mitosis/runs/field-notes/recorder-comets-and-fixes-amend-1, feature branch mitosis/recorder, --no-push). Then merge its branch into mitosis/recorder in the recorder worktree and mitosis/recorder into mitosis/voice-peaks, and review recorder as round 2 with previous_head 7b4d7dc4.
